title: Northloop Guarantee and Liability Schedule for Marketplace Orders
content:
This schedule sets out, per Marketplace Orders delivery option, the Northloop Guarantee figures and the party that funds refunds owed for loss, fulfillment error or a granted Northloop Guarantee claim.

| Delivery option | Liability party | Item-not-received wait (calendar days after promised delivery date) | Claim window (calendar days after promised delivery date) | Claim cap (USD) | Claims per order | Appeal window (calendar days after decision) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | the seller | 3 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | the seller | 3 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | Northloop | 2 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | Northloop | 2 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | Northloop | 1 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | the seller | 7 | 90 | 2500.00 | 1 | 30 |

| Delivery option | Seller claim response (business days) | Invalid-tracking item-not-received claim granted without seller response | Signature confirmation threshold (order total, USD) | Transit damage report window (calendar days after delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | 3 | Yes | 750.00 | 30 |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | 3 | Yes | 750.00 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 30 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 3 | Yes | 750.00 | 2 |

## Notes

- The item-not-received wait is the calendar days after the promised delivery date before an undelivered shipment may be reported lost or claimed under the Northloop Guarantee.
- The seller response period, the invalid-tracking setting and the signature threshold have no meaning where Northloop is the liability party.
- At or above the USD 750.00 order total, a delivered scan protects the seller against an item-not-received claim only when signature confirmation was obtained.
- Damage in transit must be reported within the transit damage report window to qualify as damaged in transit: 30 days on parcel options, 2 days on Large Item Freight Delivery.
